scheduling_methodology: One shared queue across Graph modes. Existing jobs recover on their original ports. New off jobs are all submitted before new on jobs start, but off completion is not a barrier. On jobs use reversed requested order; prepared inputs and simulation costs are unchanged.
recovery_methodology: All jobs were submitted through the frontend. This observer only performs serial GET requests on original job IDs. Each HTTP response streams to disk; one snapshot at a time is parsed, its report released, and terminal raw bytes retained without reserialization. Original submission/job_created files are preserved. Recovered report rendering is not revalidated.
